P5923.corridor_notes: This project (西二线、川气东送嘉兴联通工程) is a short point-form interconnection facility, not a long-haul linear transmission pipeline. Per the 2023-08-10 land-use pre-review notice (jiashan.gov.cn), '项目起点为天凝镇洪南村西二线管道，终点为天凝镇洪南村川气东送管道，全长0.8公里' — i.e. both the nominal start (tie-in to West-East Line 2 / 西二线上海支干线嘉兴-甪直联络线) and end (tie-in to 川气东送) are in the same village, 0.8km apart. Per the 2024-01-28 completion/environmental-acceptance notice (zjhby.com), a new interconnection station (嘉善联络站) was built at 浙江省嘉兴市嘉善县天凝镇洪南村, with filtering/metering/flow-regulation facilities and bidirectional flow capability, design pressure 10MPa, design capacity 80×10^8 Nm3/a. Construction: demolished 75m of old West-2-branch pipe, built 288.43m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station; demolished 46m of old 川气东送 pipe, built 365.73m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station. Total investment ¥199.13 million. The sasac.gov.cn article (2024-06-17, cited in prior ResearcherNotes) documents system-wide bidirectional throughput context (West-East pipeline system surpassing 500 billion m3 delivered to the Yangtze Delta) but does not name this specific site.
P5923.researcher_notes: SPECIAL NOTE per task instructions: GEM's StartLocation=EndLocation was flagged as a likely data defect, but sourced evidence indicates this is NOT actually a defect — this is genuinely a point interconnection facility (a single village/station where two trunk lines are tied together), so start and end are legitimately the same physical location (within the station footprint, tie-in points on opposite sides). What IS flagged as a likely data-quality issue: GEM's LengthMergedKm=20.00 appears inconsistent with sourced figures — the pre-review notice states 0.8km total, and the completion notice describes ~0.65km of newly built pipe (288.43m + 365.73m) plus demolished old-pipe segments (75m + 46m). Recommend flagging the 20km figure for correction in a future update pass (out of scope for this route-creation task, which is endpoints-only).

P7732.corridor_notes: Per Wenzhou Ecology & Environment Bureau's EIA acceptance notice (受理公告, 2026-05-25) and approval notice (审批意见, 批复 2026-06-12, 温环建﹝2026﹞045号), the pipeline (建设单位: 浙江浙能天然气管网有限公司) is located '温州市瑞安市、平阳县、文成县境内' — within Rui'an City, Pingyang County, AND Wencheng County (three counties, not just the two implied by GEM's Start=Rui'an/End=Wencheng — Pingyang County is an intermediate pass-through not currently reflected in GEM's location fields). Per a 2025 land-use pre-review public notice from Wencheng County's Bureau of Natural Resources & Planning, within Wencheng County the route passes through five towns/townships in this listed order: 大峃镇 (Dahong, the county seat), 峃口镇 (Kuangkou), 周山畲族乡 (Zhoushan She Ethnic Township), 公阳乡 (Gongyang), 平和乡 (Pinghe) — total project length 37.6km, of which 18.5km lies within Wencheng County (land area 1.7014 ha total / 0.7494 ha in Wencheng). This 37.6km total does NOT match GEM's LengthMergedKm=45.00 — a ~7.4km discrepancy, possibly reflecting scope/design changes between the 2025 pre-review stage and the 2026 EIA approval stage, or a difference in what is counted as the 'pipeline' vs ancillary works. A separate, likely-DISTINCT facility — 瑞安分输站 (Rui'an Distribution Station) in 汀田街道 (Tingtian Subdistrict), Rui'an City — was found as the tie-in hub for a different but nearby project (the Cangnan branch of the Yong-Tai-Wen trunk pipeline); it was NOT confirmed as this project's actual western-Rui'an start point, so it is not used as the sourced start location.
P7732.researcher_notes: Resolution reached at county/town-seat precision, not station-level, because the WebSearch tool's session-wide budget was exhausted partway through this task (shared cap consumed by concurrent sibling research agents working other PID groups in the same parent session) and fallback search engines (DuckDuckGo direct via curl, Baidu, Bing) were largely blocked by bot-detection/CAPTCHA when queried directly via curl; a workaround (WebFetch on DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint) worked intermittently and surfaced the Wencheng town list used here, but could not further resolve a specific station name for the Rui'an-side start or confirm the exact terminus among the 5 Wencheng towns. The Rui'an-Pingyang-Wencheng EIA full report PDF (which likely has precise chainage/coordinates) is hosted on a Zhejiang government OSS bucket that returns HTTP 403 to non-China-based requests (geo-blocked) — could not be retrieved or verified. Length discrepancy (37.6km per pre-review notice vs GEM's 45.00km) flagged for a future update pass, not resolved here.
P7732.blockers: Station-level start/end precision not achieved: WebSearch budget exhausted mid-task; geo-blocked EIA PDF (403) could not be read; DuckDuckGo/Baidu/Bing scraping via curl was intermittently blocked by bot detection. County/town-seat-level coordinates used instead, each backed by a verified official government source.

P7755.corridor_notes: Per Zhejiang Development & Reform Commission's official 14th Five-Year Plan for Coal, Petroleum and Natural Gas Development (fzggw.zj.gov.cn, published 2021-07-07 — the same document already cited by a prior researcher for this pipeline), the route is explicitly described as running '乐清登陆站-温州末站，管径1219mm，设计压力10MPa，长度约46公里' (Yueqing Landing Station to Wenzhou [line-end] Station, diameter 1219mm, design pressure 10MPa, length ~46km) — the 46km figure matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=46.00 exactly, strong corroboration this is the correct project. A related (but not confirmed identical) facility was found via a 2023 trade-press article (shifair.com): imported LNG from 浙能温州LNG接收站 (the Zheneng Wenzhou LNG Receiving Terminal, located at 温州市洞头区大门镇小门岛 / Xiaomen Island, Damen Town, Dongtou District) is injected into the Zhejiang provincial gas network via ~26km of external transmission pipeline at a facility called 乐清分输站 (Yueqing Distribution Station) — this may or may not be the same station as '乐清登陆站' named in the FYP document; not confirmed either way.
P7755.researcher_notes: Resolution reached at city-level precision only, not station-level, because the exact locations of 乐清登陆站 and 温州末站 could not be pinned down: neither is a mapped OSM place/POI, and the WebSearch tool's session-wide budget was exhausted partway through this task (shared cap consumed by concurrent sibling research agents), forcing reliance on a partially-blocked DuckDuckGo-via-WebFetch workaround that returned no results for either exact station name. If finer precision is needed later, worth trying: (1) the full PDF/report behind the FYP webpage (may have a route map), (2) searching '洞头 华港LNG 北白象分输站' (a different but geographically related Dongtou-to-Beibaixiang line surfaced during this search, in case it shares infrastructure), (3) re-running once WebSearch budget resets.
P7755.blockers: Station-level start/end precision not achieved (WebSearch budget exhausted mid-task; alternate search engines blocked/CAPTCHA'd via direct curl). City-level government-building coordinates used as proxies instead, backed by one verified official source (fzggw.zj.gov.cn) that names both stations by name and corroborates the exact 46km length.

P7756.corridor_notes: Per Zhejiang Development & Reform Commission's official 14th Five-Year Plan for Coal, Petroleum and Natural Gas Development (fzggw.zj.gov.cn, 2021-07-07 — the same document already cited by a prior researcher for the neighboring Yueqing-Wenzhou pipeline), the route is described as '龙港—苍南天然气管道...由龙港延伸至苍南县灵溪镇境内，管径813mm，设计压力6.3MPa，长度约27公里' (Longgang-Cangnan Gas Pipeline, extending from Longgang to within Lingxi Town, Cangnan County, diameter 813mm, design pressure 6.3MPa, length ~27km) — the 27km figure matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=27.00 exactly, strong corroboration this is the correct project and that Lingxi Town (the Cangnan county seat) is the intended endpoint, not just 'Cangnan County' generically. A Longgang municipal gas special-plan document (关于龙港市燃气专项规划) was found via search and names 龙港分输站 (Longgang Distribution Station) as the city's current gas-source tie-in point on the Ningbo-Taizhou-Wenzhou (甬台温) trunk pipeline — plausibly this pipeline's actual start point — but that PDF is hosted on a Zhejiang government OSS bucket that fails scripts/url_verifier.py (HTTP 403, geo-blocked to non-China IPs), so it is NOT used as a ref and 龙港分输站 is not asserted as a confirmed start point; noted here for context/follow-up only.
P7756.researcher_notes: Resolution reached at city/town-seat precision only, not station-level, for the same reasons as the sibling PIDs in this batch: WebSearch budget exhausted mid-task (shared session-wide cap), and the one PDF source that names a specific Longgang-side station (龙港分输站) is geo-blocked and fails url_verifier.py, so could not be cited. Worth a follow-up search for 龙港分输站's exact coordinates once tooling allows (it is very likely the real start point, per the two independent mentions found: this planning PDF and a separate news article about 苍南末站 being located within old 龙港镇).
P7756.blockers: Station-level start precision not achieved (龙港分输站's exact location could not be confirmed via a URL that passes url_verifier.py — the one source found is geo-blocked/403). City-level (Longgang) and town-seat-level (Lingxi) coordinates used instead, backed by one verified official source (fzggw.zj.gov.cn) that corroborates the exact 27km length and names Lingxi Town as the terminus.
